title: Real LLM Demo Operator Script
description: Machine-testable checklist for an operator-led real LLM output demo. It replays existing real DSL artifacts, evidence summaries, and static frontend pages without sending new model requests or publishing generated content.

demoFlow.title: Read real demo boundary
demoFlow.expectedSignal: The source bundle may contain real LLM outputs, but this script only replays existing files and static pages.
demoFlow.speakerCue: Start by saying this is a real-output demo replay, not a new model call or publish flow.

demoFlow.title: Open Real Demo page
demoFlow.expectedSignal: RealDemoOneClickChecklist shows readyForDemo=true, acceptance=7/7, sections=6/6, and gradingEvidenceCoverage=100/100.
demoFlow.speakerCue: Use this as the first screen: it proves the real DSL artifacts, evidence, PPTX artifact, review queue, and safety boundary are linked.

demoFlow.title: Confirm generated DSL artifacts wait for review
demoFlow.expectedSignal: generated_dsl section passes and Lab, Exam, Grading, and PPT are all WAITING_REVIEW.
demoFlow.speakerCue: Explain that real model output is converted to DSL first and stays blocked until manual review.

demoFlow.title: Open Review Center
demoFlow.expectedSignal: RealDemoReviewQueue shows four WAITING_REVIEW artifacts and keeps autoApproveAllowed=false and batchStateChangeAllowed=false.
demoFlow.speakerCue: Show that reviewers see the real demo queue but cannot batch approve or publish.

demoFlow.title: Open PPT page review
demoFlow.expectedSignal: PPTX Artifact is visible for page-level review and remains WAITING_REVIEW.
demoFlow.speakerCue: Point out that PPT files can be inspected page by page, but no generated slide is published automatically.

demoFlow.title: Open Grading Report
demoFlow.expectedSignal: Controlled Docker evidence covers 40/40 and static Notebook evidence covers 60/60, totaling gradingEvidenceCoverage=100/100.
demoFlow.speakerCue: Explain the evidence split: controlled container checks plus static Notebook JSON parsing, still requiring human review.

demoFlow.title: Demo MCP review revision loop
demoFlow.operatorAction: python lab_cli.py mcp call --tool request_review_revision --arguments "{\"taskId\":\"<task_id>\",\"reviewer\":\"teacher_1\",\"comment\":\"补充步骤截图验收标准。\",\"priority\":\"HIGH\",\"targetSections\":[\"steps\"]}"
demoFlow.expectedSignal: MCP tools request_review_revision and regenerate_from_revision_mock are available; source task remains WAITING_REVIEW and regenerated mock task is also WAITING_REVIEW.
demoFlow.speakerCue: Show that an Agent can ask for reviewer changes and a revised draft through tools, while still keeping review and publish blocked.

demoFlow.title: Validate one-click checklist JSON
demoFlow.operatorAction: python lab_cli.py phase2 demo-bundle checklist --bundle examples/output/real-llm-demo-bundle.json --acceptance-summary examples/output/real-llm-demo-acceptance-summary.json --output examples/output/real-llm-demo-checklist.json
demoFlow.expectedSignal: CLI returns success=true and demoChecklist.summary.readyForDemo=true; frontend contract keeps RealDemoOneClickChecklist visible.
demoFlow.speakerCue: Use this command only to regenerate the local checklist JSON; it does not call the model or run grading.

demoFlow.title: Confirm blocked actions
demoFlow.expectedSignal: newLlmRequestSent=false, secretsRead=false, networkAccess=false, sandboxExecutedByChecklist=false, commandExecutedByChecklist=false, and realPublishAllowed=false.
demoFlow.speakerCue: Close by saying the demo proves real outputs can be reviewed, not that they can bypass review or publish.

acceptanceSignals.expected: Lab, Exam, Grading, and PPT DSL artifacts are schemaValidated=true and WAITING_REVIEW.
gradingEvidenceCoverage reaches 100/100 with manualReviewRequired=true and autoApproveAllowed=false.
Review Center and MCP get_review_task_summary expose the real demo queue for human triage.
MCP request_review_revision records feedback and regenerate_from_revision_mock creates a new WAITING_REVIEW draft without a real LLM request or publish.
No new LLM request, secret read, network access, checklist sandbox execution, batch state change, or real publish is allowed.

blockedActions: Do not send a new real LLM request during the demo
Do not read or display API keys or secrets
Do not access the network from the checklist
Do not run Docker, pytest, Notebook kernels, or contestant code from this script
Do not reveal candidate-hidden standard answers
Do not batch approve, auto approve, auto publish, or real publish generated artifacts
